Case reference: 2012020038.CaseDesc: Desiree Oldwoman was last seen on August 27, 2011 in the vicinity of her home on the Siksika First Nation Reserve near Gleichen, Alberta. She has been diagnosed with autism and is non-verbal, although she has developed the ability to write her name.

Case reference: 2014002090.CaseDesc: On February 28, 2000, Stephane Levesque was seen for the last time at his home in the Verdun district of Montreal, Quebec. Stephane went to move his car from one side of the street to the other, and he never came back. Car keys belonging to Stephane were found in his vehicle.

Coat: Black, Winter coat with "Skidoo" written in yellow

Case reference: 2017073542.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2016, an unidentified man was discovered in Lake Ontario in St. Catharines, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he was of East Asian Ancestry.

Case reference: 2014002959.CaseDesc: On December 1, 1998, Frederick Pilkington was seen for the last time near the Table Rock area in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Frederick was despondent.

Hair: Grey, Bald, Other, Short, Partially bald

Case reference: 2016006093.CaseDesc: On January 19, 2016, Michelle Smits was seen for the last time as she travelled from Cambridge, Ontario to the United States. In February, Michelle’s vehicle was found abandoned in Boston, Massachusetts.

Case reference: 2019033665.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1988, the remains of a male were found in a field on the side of road 132 in Tracy, Québec. A camp was found near the remains.

Case reference: 2014005346.CaseDesc: In August of 1987, Dale Sinclair was last seen as he left his home in Edmonton, Alberta, driving his wife’s vehicle. Dale had planned to cash a cheque at the bank, and then intended on visiting family in Gibbons, Alberta. On August 12, 1987, the vehicle he was driving was recovered by the police in Regina, Saskatchewan.

Case reference: 2014002002.CaseDesc: On September 17, 1977, Gaetan Pichette was seen for the last time in the Verdun district of Montreal, Quebec. His family and friends have not seen or heard from him since.

Tattoo: Right Arm, Arm tattoo, inscribed with "COCU"

Case reference: 2018062675.CaseDesc: On November 3, 2018, Aaron Normandeau was seen for the last time by a friend on the Ottawa River in an aluminum boat. The boat capsized and Aaron went under the water and did not resurface.

Case reference: 2020011116.CaseDesc: Glen Peddle had been hitchhiking through the United States between 1982 and 1985. In April 1985, Glen called his mother from New York to tell her that he was planning on returning home to Newfoundland in the spring, but never returned home.

Case reference: 2019002992.CaseDesc: On August 25, 2018, Anupama Nadagouda was seen for the last time with her daughter, Anvita Mulemane, in India.

Case reference: 2012020067.CaseDesc: Bonnie Polwarth went missing from Brandon, Manitoba, on March 15, 1995. She had been undergoing counselling at the Brandon Mental Health Centre at the time of her disappearance. She is thought to have walked out of the facility on her own the day she went missing. She was supposed to be at work at 2:00 p.m. that day, but she did not show up and has been missing ever since.  Bonnie may have a forearm tattoo.

Jacket: Cream, Ivory, With green and brown

Case reference: 2013000037.CaseDesc: On November 29, 2001, Henry Murillo Asprilla was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. On that day, he had a meeting with lawyers, which he attended with his ex-wife. After the meeting he drove his ex-wife home. Henry has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003985.CaseDesc: On November 28, 1974 Randall Crighton was seen for the last time in Richmond, British Columbia. He was involved in a motor vehicle accident with a friend who had left the scene. Randall has not been seen or heard from since. Randall had substance abuse problems and may have been despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014001384.CaseDesc: On March 12, 1974, Gilles Larose was seen for the last time in Vancouver, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2015049499.CaseDesc: Loretta Garrett's husband and friends reported her missing on July 19, 1961 from Moose Brook River in Northesk Parish, New Brunswick. They were on a fishing trip and shared a car and parked near the trailhead. The men hiked across a trail until they reached the water to fish, while the women remained in the car. Shortly after, Loretta complained about the heat and bugs and started down the same trail as the men, but she was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014004294.CaseDesc: On May 28, 2001, Jean-Paul Leroux was seen for the last time when he left his spouse’s residence in Montreal, Quebec.  Jean-Paul's vehicle was located abandoned 7 days later in the parking lot of the Saint-Leonard shopping centre. Jean-Paul has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001312.CaseDesc: John McAllister was last seen leaving his home on May 7, 1973. The truck belonging to John was later found near Lodgepole, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014005451.CaseDesc: John W. Burton and two passengers (Clifford Dowson and Edward Flett) were flying from Oxford House to Island Lake in Manitoba. John Burton was the pilot of the Cessna 185 and at approximately 11:00 a.m. he made a routine radio call stating that the plane would be landing at Garden Hill in approximately 15 minutes. The plane never arrived at its destination. The wreckage and all three souls on board were never located.

Case reference: 2006021799.CaseDesc: Leo Payash, was last seen on July 01, 1957. He and his mother Cecilia Payash, were walking on Red Lake Road in Ontario, and neither has been seen since.

Deformity: Nose, Described as having a "hooked" nose

Case reference: 2014006268.CaseDesc: On September 25, 2013, Brandon Jakobek was seen for the last time flying a plane from Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario. Brandon, a Morningstar Air pilot and avid skydiver, had flown in from Toronto to deliver parcels for FedEx. He had informed employees prior to his departure that a warning light had illuminated during his flight and that he needed to run some diagnostic checks. The plane was never found and is thought to be in the Hudson Bay.

Case reference: 2016066833.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1982, an unidentified male was discovered in the Detroit River, near Fighting Island. His post-mortem length was estimated as being between 5'6"-5'8",  however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. It is estimated he was in the water for no more than 6 months.

Jacket: Parka or hooded jacket, which had both a zipper and snap fasteners

Case reference: 2014001191.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2010, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Richelieu River in Saint-Mathias-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. In his possession were a "Hipstreet" brand MP3 player and headphones. The images shown are facial approximation portraits of this unidentified man created by the Sûreté du Québec.

Case reference: 2014001419.CaseDesc: On December 4th, 1993 Elizabeth Mitchell was seen for the last time at her residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. Her abandoned vehicle was found later that morning near Tablerock, Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance, Elizabeth was despondent.

Scar: Shoulders, Surgical scar on left shoulder

Case reference: 2021036430.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2012, John Fruehauf was last seen near the American Falls located at Prospect Point in Niagara Falls, New York. At the time of his disappearance, John was despondent.

Shirt: Other, Light coloured worn underneath the long sleeve.
Other, Dark coloured with long sleeves

Case reference: 2013000038.CaseDesc: Samuel Lachance was last seen at the Beverage Room in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan near the end of July, 1987. Samuel was in very good physical condition at the time of his disappearance and worked in different logging camps in Saskatchewan. Family members say that it was unusual for Samuel not to have any contact with them or his friends near the time he was last seen.

Case reference: 2012020147.CaseDesc: On March 25, 1996, the skeletal remains of a man were found near the Upper Levels Highway in West Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had recovered from severe injuries to his right arm and leg. He also had a fractured skull, nose and ribs. These injuries were likely a result of a single major accident. It is estimated that he may have died several months prior to the discovery of his remains.

Jacket: Corduroy, Purple, Lavender, Mauve, 3/4 length coat with fleece
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Side Of Head, Recent fracture to the left temporal bone above the left ear
Nose, Old nasal fracture with visible deformity
Deformity: Shoulders, Old injury; no indication of which shoulder

Case reference: 2014004910.CaseDesc: Dillirajah Suppiah was last seen in 2002, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2006010699.CaseDesc: Greg Gan departed from the family home in Kenora, Ontario, on foot, on October 19, 1978. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003550.CaseDesc: Kenneth James Schmit, who went by "Jimmy", was last seen leaving a social gathering at a home in St. Walburg, Saskatchewan at 10:30 p.m. on September 22, 1966. Kenneth was feeling despondent, and, at the time of his disappearance, he sported a heavy beard. Numerous searches of the area were conducted, however, he was not located.

Case reference: 2013000033.CaseDesc: Bernard Deromer was last seen at the metro station Berri-UQAM (University of Quebec in Montreal) on June 5, 1982 in Montreal, Quebec. Bernard is blind and walks with a white cane. He may have been approached by a religious sect.

Teeth: Other, Upper front tooth obliquely broken
Chain: worn around neck, with several medals
Other: blind and walks with a white cane
Scar: Right Ear, near the right ear

Case reference: 2014006177.CaseDesc: On October 9, 1987, around 9:00 p.m., Phillip Orvis took his boat out on Lake Winnipeg from Matheson Island in Manitoba. He was on his way to his fishing camp on Black Bear Island. By the time he left, the water on the lake was very rough. Phillip could not swim and was known to never wear a life jacket. His boat was found the next day. It was full of water and was drifting towards the mainland about 1 Km south-east of the dock from which he is believed to have left. Land, air and water searches were carried out, as well as dragging operations on the lake, but his body was never found. Phillip is presumed to have drowned and foul play is not suspected.

Case reference: 2006009699.CaseDesc: Dwayne Lee left his residence on December 24th,1999. His vehicle was located December 26, 1999, at Gray's Beach, Thousand Island's Parkway in the Township of Leeds and Thousand Islands.

Case reference: 2013000136.CaseDesc: Joseph Moore was last seen on October 31, 2012 by his employer in Kincardine, Ontario.  He was reported missing on November 12, 2012. Upon investigation, Joseph's apartment was found neat and tidy and his clothing and luggage had been left behind. Joseph is known to suffer from severe depression. The last potential sighting was at the Kincardine Davidson Centre on November 8, 2012.  A media blitz was done to request feedback for missing person Joseph Moore with limited feedback. An extensive search of the area was conducted with negative results.

Case reference: 2014005630.CaseDesc: Melissa Janette Ekkelenkamp was last seen on July 06, 2011 when she left the Alberta Hospital located in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2006005599.CaseDesc: On October 25, 1980, Foster Bezanson departed the Abitibi Road 48 area near Cochrane, Ontario to go hunting and he never returned.

Case reference: 2014004987.CaseDesc: On September 6, 2004, Cassandra Wright was seen for the last time leaving the Homewood Shelter in Toronto, Ontario. Cassandra said that she would be back in the morning.

Case reference: 2013000144.CaseDesc: Robert Angelo Furgiuele from Sault Ste-Marie, Ontario was last seen in Squamish, British-Columbia in 1991. He was residing in Squamish with his girlfriend and his daughter. He was working in a grocery store at the time. He last spoke to his mother by telephone in 1991. He might have moved to Vancouver Island, British-Columbia in 1992.

Case reference: 2008007999.CaseDesc: On September 19, 1980, Charles Leslie Lewis and a friend were out fishing on Gullrock Lake approximately 10km south of Red Lake in the Kenora District in Ontario. While they were out on the lake the winds picked up and began to create large waves, which caused the boat to capsize. Charles and his friend clung to the bottom of the boat but were pushed off several times by the waves. Charles was washed away from the boat. As he attempted to swim back to the boat, his head kept going under water.  At one point he did not resurface.

Jacket: Canvas, Brown, Orange, Hunting - ONG shoulder patches

Case reference: 2014005502.CaseDesc: Pinaskin Ottawa was last seen shopping on October 11, 2010, around 11:00 a.m. at the Atikamekw Community Grocery Store in Manawan, Quebec. Since then, several investigations have been conducted in the vicinity of Manawan without success. Pinaskin has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2016068711.CaseDesc: On September 30, 1969, an unidentified male was found 0.8 kilometres west of Sioux Lookout. His death appears to be self-inflicted

Case reference: 2020011478.CaseDesc: On November 15, 1988, Mary McCarthy was seen for the last time at her apartment in Toronto, Ontario. Mary’s vehicle was later found on November 17, 1988 at the bus depot in Niagara Falls, Ontario. Mary was a chartered accountant working for CSA Management Ltd. at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2006015499.CaseDesc: Richard Ranger was last seen on March 4, 1999, at Buster's Confectionary on Main Street in Haileybury.  Richard had been admitted to the Temiskaming Hospital for psychiatric assessment the same day he went missing and may suffer from mental illness. His whereabouts are unknown and foul play is not suspected at this time.

Case reference: 2026007673.CaseDesc: Toward the end of November 2025, Roger Rochon was last seen in Joliette, Quebec, as he was getting ready to take the bus to Toronto, Ontario. The investigation revealed that he was in Toronto in early January 2026 because he wanted to explore and travel across Ontario.

Scar: Right Cheek, Superficial wound; a graze

Case reference: 2023041781.CaseDesc: On or about March 21, 2018 Daniel Chambers was last seen in the area of Niagara Falls, New York, USA. At the time of his disappearance, Daniel was despondent.

Case reference: 2025049755.CaseDesc: On July 23, 2025, US officials responded to the base of the North Grand Island Bridge in New York following a report of a boating accident on the Niagara River in Niagara Falls, New York.  Jerome Williams and another passenger were thrown overboard. The other occupant was eventually recovered but Jerome remains missing.

Jewelry: Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Watch, Rolex Yacht-Master brand

Case reference: 2014004591.CaseDesc: In July 2004, Philip Leishman left his residence with a friend from Kakisa Lake, Northwest Territories. Philip had told his family that he would be travelling to Fort McMurray, Alberta, and it was confirmed that he was in Fort McMurray until late August of 2004. Philip has ties to Port Alberni, British Columbia, Grande Prairie, Alberta, and Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014003919.CaseDesc: On September 19, 2000, Ronald Montgomery went missing from his home in Calgary, Alberta. Ronald has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2006023499.CaseDesc: Viola Panacheese was last seen on August 18, 1991 walking on Lakeshore Avenue in Sioux Lookout, Ontario.  She wears glasses but was not wearing them at the time of her disappearance.

Scar: Right Shin, burn scar from knee to ankle

Case reference: 2014005000.CaseDesc: On August 10, 2004, Louis Lathlin was reported missing to police by his wife. She told police the last time she saw him was on June 14, when he left The Pas for Winnipeg, Manitoba for a doctor's appointment on the 15th. He took only personal hygiene items and no clothing. He later called his wife and told her that he would be staying in Winnipeg as he had another appointment on Thursday. He called his wife on Saturday morning requesting money. His wife sent the money as requested, but by Tuesday it had not been claimed. Louis has a history of living on the streets and has ties to Edmonton where he spent years on the streets. He also has various medical issues. He is believed to be in Winnipeg of his own volition. Louis' whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014006037.CaseDesc: On the evening of March 21, 2013, Bruno Pouliot was last seen in a pharmacy located in Saint-Pierre-de-l’île-d’Orléans, Québec. Bruno lived in the Donnacona, Quebec area and was known to go snowshoeing on the frozen St. Lawrence River.  Family members have reasons to be concerned about his well-being.

Case reference: 2014004610.CaseDesc: On June 7, 1967, Absolom Halkett and his colleague, James Brady, were dropped off by plane at Foster Lake, SK, which is located 120 miles north west of La Ronge, SK. The two were prospecting in the area. They were last heard from on a radio call to a nearby mine on June 8th. Extensive land, air and water searches of the area failed to locate any trace of the two men. Their camp was located but had been unused.

Case reference: 2014004048.CaseDesc: Dwayne Allen Rideout was last seen on September 24, 1999 at the Generator Cabaret on 3rd Avenue in Prince George, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2017060723.CaseDesc: On October 9, 2017, Amber Barlow was last seen in the area of 107 Street and 152 Avenue, Edmonton, Alberta.  Amber engages in a high-risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2022037048.CaseDesc: On June 20, 2008, the body of an unidentified man was recovered from Lake Erie, approximately one mile off the north end of Woodlawn Beach in Buffalo, New York.

Jacket: Dark Blue, Brand: Carhartt; size: small
Sweater: Blue, Sweatshirt with cut off sleeves
Blue, Pullover sweater; brand: Mountain Expedition

Case reference: 2006018899.CaseDesc: William Bowman was last seen leaving his hunting camp, 83 kilometres north of the Town of Massey, Ontario, at the north end of Hwy.# 810, District Algoma, Monestine Township on October 15, 1979.

Case reference: 2006024099.CaseDesc: David Jennings was last seen on June 13, 1991. He is presumed to have drowned on Blackstone Lake in Archipelago Township.

Jacket: Silk, Blue, across shoulders "Bass Fishing"  picture bass fish

Case reference: 2014005069.CaseDesc: On February 27, 2008, at approximately 3:00 p.m., Kien Hua was seen for the last time by his friend in Toronto, Ontario. Kien had told his friend that he was going to borrow his parents' car and was leaving town for a couple of days. On March 4, 2008, his parents' vehicle was found abandoned in Montreal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2016032179.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1944, Richard David Marlow was seen for the last time riding his bike in front of his family’s home in Etobicoke, Ontario. Later that evening, when Richard’s mother returned home, his bike was found at the house. Richard was a good child at home, and in school, and had no reason to run away.

Socks: Cotton, Grey, Yellow band at top

Case reference: 2014004475.CaseDesc: On the morning of October 1, 1976, Crystal Van Huuksloot was seen for the last time with her suitcases in Toronto, Ontario. Crystal had traveled from Edmonton, Alberta to help raise funds for her boyfriend. She stayed in Toronto for one week, but did not board her return flight to Edmonton.

Case reference: 2006006699.CaseDesc: Eric Larsfolk and John McCormick were last seen playing at the McCormick farm in Caledon. They have not been seen since.

Case reference: 2022019657.CaseDesc: On January 9, 1989, Richard Figura was seen for the last time near the brink of the American Falls in Niagara Falls, New York. During the time of his disappearance, Richard was despondent.

Case reference: 2020046338.CaseDesc: On March 3, 1974, Wilfred McArdon set sail from Victoria, British Columbia in a small boat with the intention of reaching Ucluelet, British Columbia three days later; however, he never arrived. Wilfred's boat is described as a 20' Spencer manufactured wood cabin vessel Reg# 13K30727.

Case reference: 2018040276.CaseDesc: On November 2, 1992, at approximately 12:00pm, Luom Truong was last seen leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Prior to leaving his home, Luom and his mother had an argument.

Case reference: 2014002748.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1981, Jerry Torarak was last seen at 11:15 p.m. near Hopedale, Newfoundland & Labardor. Jerry had been travelling back to Hopedale from Railroads, Newfoundland & Labrador via boat with his family. Approximately 23 kilometers off shore from Hopedale, Jerry fell over board into the water and sank out of sight.

Case reference: 2014001029.CaseDesc: On February 11, 1992, the body of this man was discovered on a beach in the vicinity of Hesquiat, located on the west coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia. He had sustained a previous injury to his right knee, which had resulted in arthritis, and he was likely to have originated from the United States.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Knee, Compression fracture of the right proximal tibia, accompanied by arthritis

Case reference: 2014001323.CaseDesc: Mary Kreiser was last seen on September 16 1987 at the Petro Canada gas station in Westlock, Alberta.  She has not been heard from since October 1987. It is believed that Mary may be in the Vancouver, British Columbia area.

Case reference: 2014002841.CaseDesc: Michel Gagné was last seen on June 29, 1982, in Montreal, Quebec. Michel left his friend's mother's home to go with him to a medical clinic and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014003278.CaseDesc: Janette Brunet left her home in Ottawa, Ontario on January 30 1988 and went with friends to a local pub in the Mechanicsville neighbourhood. Janette was last seen in the parking lot of Ozzie's Pub on Holland Avenue at 1:00 a.m. on January 31 1988.

Hair: Brown, Dyed, Sometimes dyes her hair

Case reference: 2018040111.CaseDesc: Mackenzie De Vos was reported missing from Ottawa, Ontario in July 2018 by his family, who had not heard from him since January of that year. We have been unable to identify any record of passport use, and both the Ministry of Transportation Ontario (MTO) and the Ontario Health Insurance Plan (OHIP) have no updates to report.

Case reference: 2014004864.CaseDesc: On November 6, 2006, at approximately 9:00 a.m., Ahmed Moalin-Mohamed was seen for the last time as he left his apartment to search for employment in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014008789.CaseDesc: Martin "Marty" Leger was reported missing on May 29, 2014 from the area of Spider Lake road, near the town of Waverley, in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Marty had left his place of employment and went for a bike ride on the trails in the area of Spider Lake and never returned.

Case reference: 2014004752.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2005 a man attended the Victoria Police Department and reported not seeing Belinda Cameron for over one month.  He told police Belinda had mentioned wanting to visit relatives in Vancouver and Manitoba but did not provide names to police.  This man reported sharing an intimate relationship with Belinda outside of his own marriage.  He said she was not a habitual runaway.  This man denied harming Belinda and through a Polygraph examination was determined to be honest.  The Victoria Police investigated Belinda's disappearance and determined that Belinda suffered from a mental illness, had a drug addiction and may have been a sex trade worker.  The last confirmed sighting of Belinda was at Shoppers Drug Mart at 870 Esquimalt Rd.  She failed to attend thereafter to pick up her daily medication.

Hair: Black, Long, Separated in the middle

Case reference: 2015059337.CaseDesc: On July 26, 2015, at approximately 10:30 p.m., Van Huong was last seen on vacation in Vietnam. The next morning, Van’s family noticed he had left the hotel room and had not returned.

Case reference: 2017060465.CaseDesc: On September 24, 2017, Jesse Clint Galganov was seen for the last time when he took a flight to Peru from the Montréal-Pierre-Elliott Trudeau Airport in Montreal, Quebec. On September 28, 2017, Jesse contacted his mother to tell her that he was going to go hiking for a few days in the forest. Since this time, Jesse has not been seen nor has he contacted his family to provide them with his whereabouts which is contrary to his habits.

Shoes: Black, White, Running shoes with white soles

Case reference: 2016069642.CaseDesc: On April 21, 1995, the remains of a woman were discovered near Carbon, Alberta. The post-mortem interval is estimated to be between 10 and 15 years. The individual had dental restorations including stainless steel crowns.

Case reference: 2014004979.CaseDesc: On July 23, 2007, Gad Krespine, a resident of Montreal, was last seen at approximately 10:30 A.M., at 1755 Lierre Street in Laval, Quebec.

Case reference: 2019052355.CaseDesc: Bjorn Collnes was last seen on September 9, 2019 in Falkland, British Columbia. On the same day, the police located Bjorn's brown minivan, which had been abandoned on Highway 97, west of Westwold, British Columbia.

Right Arm, Heart with a dagger on right arm

Case reference: 2014001485.CaseDesc: On July 31, 1981, Mohamad Daher was seen for the last time as he left his residence, in the Anjou district in Montreal, Quebec, for a business meeting. His vehicle was found at Le Boulevard Shopping Centre in the Saint-Leonard neighbourhood. Mohamad has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003382.CaseDesc: On May 27, 1988, Stanley Umpherville and a friend were driving to The Pas, Manitoba where they stayed the night. In the morning the two departed The Pas via a 20 foot yawl with the intent on going to Easterville. They departed the Umpherville settlement around 1300hrs and they briefly stopped at Pine Bluff around 1600 hrs. It is believed they then stopped at a friend's trappers cabin at Rat Hunting and ate a meal. The last thing the survivor remembers, is seeing the lights of Easterville and he crawled to the front of the boat where he fell asleep. He awoke around 0500 hrs the next day and Stanley was no longer in the boat and he was adrift. Numerous islands and shorelines in the area were searched, and several air and water patrols were made without success. Stanley has not been located and his whereabouts are unknown.

Hat: Grey, Baseball style with "Hi Ho Hi Ho" on front

Case reference: 2020006631.CaseDesc: On June 30, 1980, Alan Hood was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Alan was despondent.

Case reference: 2018041450.CaseDesc: On July 19, 1999, Fakhri Daoud was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Fakhri had returned to his residence to gather some money, his passport, and some of his personal belongings. The day before, he had purchased a one-way flight ticket to Aman, Jordan.

Case reference: 2019070875.CaseDesc: On April 17, 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a crawl space of a triplex in Montreal, Québec.

Case reference: 2006013399.CaseDesc: Dustin Rhodes was last seen on July 6,1991, around 11:00 am near his cottage on Gibson Lake in Timmins, Ontario. His truck was found at that location but he wasn’t seen again.

Pants: Cotton, Grey, Blue, Grey or blue work pants

Case reference: 2016050062.CaseDesc: On August 31, 2016, Jami Springer was last seen in Moncton, New Brunswick.  Since then, no one has heard or seen Jami, and the police consider her disappearance as suspicious.

Case reference: 2014006547.CaseDesc: Gregory Caesar was last seen near Watson Lake, Yukon Territory, in October, 2009. He was hitchhiking along the Alaska Highway and was believed to be heading to the Lower Mainland area of British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014003747.CaseDesc: Karoly John "Charles" Horvath, a visitor from England, arrived in Kelowna BC in early May 1989. Case reference: 2014002743.CaseDesc: On January 16, 1994, Yoann Crouzatier was reported missing after leaving the family residence in Laval, Quebec. Yoann has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005156.CaseDesc: On October 15, 2002, Jeanne Ouellette was seen for the last time at a Starbucks coffeehouse in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002034.CaseDesc: In 1968, Christina Littlejohn was last seen on the Roseau River First Nation reserve in Manitoba. In 2002, the RCMP’s Cold Case Unit laid murder charges against her common law partner, however he passed away before the trial commenced. To date Christina’s remains have not been located.

Case reference: 2012030001.CaseDesc: In April 2011, both parents took their son, Aleksander to visit the mother's family in Poland. The father came back to Canada on his own on May 13, 2011. The mother, Elzbieta Nowacki and child did not return to Canada.

Case reference: 2014003432.CaseDesc: On August 3, 1979, June Johnson was driven by a friend to the Marlboro Hotel in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan. We have not had any communication or sighting of June since that time.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2014001603.CaseDesc: On February 2, 1992, Richard Liboiron was seen for the last time as he left a hotel in Gatineau, Quebec. Richard and a friend departed from the hotel on a snowmobile heading in the direction towards Ottawa. The two crossed the Ottawa River and did not make it to the shore.

Case reference: 2024010813.CaseDesc: Earl Aragona was reported missing on February 4, 2024 by family members. Earl’s vehicle was later located abandoned in a parking lot near the Goat Island Bridge in Niagara Falls, New York, USA.

Hair: Black, Short, Full black and grey beard

Case reference: 2022032399.CaseDesc: On May 25, 2022, partial skeletal remains of this man were found in a forested area near Salmon Arm, British Columbia. He had a severe fracture to his right lower leg during life, which required surgical intervention. He likely died many months to years before his remains were found.

Foreign Object: Right Leg, fracture to right tibia with surgical implant
